description:
Nallamuthu is a dedicated Software Developer with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), currently contributing to projects at Standard Chartered Bank in Malaysia. Passionate about building reliable and efficient software solutions, he enjoys solving technical challenges and delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced banking environment.

With a strong focus on collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, Nallamuthu is committed to developing technology that creates real business value. He believes that consistency, teamwork, and a problem-solving mindset are the foundation of successful software development, and he continues to grow professionally by embracing new technologies and challenging opportunities.
